summary: Skier killed in avalanche, Front Range
notes: Reported in avalanche-center 2015-16 season index; details not in opened source Run 61 CAIC merge: CAIC 2015-16 season table records 1 climber caught, buried and killed at St Marys Lake, Front Range on 2016-01-16; location narrowed from 'Front Range' to St Marys Lake (St. Mary's Glacier area, Clear Creek Co). Cf. id 2045 (Alpine 4-day search for missing 50 YOM at St. Mary's Glacier, same dates) — not confirmed same event.
